사건 이벤트와 일반 메시지를 받아 담당 그룹에 전달하는 API입니다. 시: Receives incident events and ordinary messages and delivers them to the responsible group. To test, use `dry_run=true` to see the result without storing or sending anything.
기존 Slack 발신자와 모니터링 도구(Alertmanager, Graf: Entry points for existing Slack senders and monitoring tools (Alertmanager, Grafana, Uptime Kuma, Sentry, Datadog)
관리 화면에서 발급한 클라이언트 토큰 또는 서버에 설정한 소스 토큰: A client token from the admin UI, or a source token configured on the server
true이면 인증·검증·변환·경로 결정까지만 하고 저장·발송하지 않습니다: If true, the server authenticates, validates, converts, and routes the request, but it does not store or send anything. The response shows what would be stored and the route.
Event ID chosen by the sender. Reuse it only for an identical retry.
Key that groups events of one problem into one incident. Use a new key after recovery.
Increasing sequence within an incident. Only a higher sequence changes the state.
If true, the event is a recovery and resolves the incident.
ID that links related incidents. It does not mean cause and effect.
새 사건 또는 상태 변경 접수: New incident or state change accepted
같은 이벤트의 재전송, 또는 dry_run 결과: Retry of the same event, or a dry_run result
같은 event_id에 다른 내용, 또는 해결된 사건 키 재사용: Different content for the same event_id, or reuse of a resolved incident key
Identical content from the same client within 60 seconds is grouped into one message.
If true, the responsible group is mentioned in Slack.
재전송이나 중복 묶음, 또는 dry_run 결과: Retry or grouped duplicate, or a dry_run result
같은 event_id에 다른 내용: Different content for the same event_id
메시지, 중복 수, 확인 기록, 다른 채널 발송: Message, duplicate count, confirmations, and deliveries to other channels
없거나 다른 클라이언트의 메시지: Unknown message, or a message of another client
토큰의 서비스 확인: Get the service of the token
클라이언트 토큰이면 서비스 이름, 소스 토큰이면 null: The service name for a client token, or null for a source token
Up to 100 incidents. A client token sees only its own incidents.
사건, 이벤트, 발송 기록, 연결 사건: Incident, events, deliveries, and related incidents
없거나 다른 클라이언트의 사건: Unknown incident, or an incident of another client
Only a source token configured on the server can use this.
대기, 실패, 가장 이른 예정 시각: Pending and failed jobs, and the earliest due time
Slack Incoming Webhook 형식으로 보내기: Send in Slack incoming webhook format
기존 Slack webhook 발신자는 URL만 바꾸면 됩니다. 토큰이: An existing Slack webhook sender only changes the URL. The URL contains the token, so rotate the token in the admin UI if the URL leaks.
Environment to use when the alert or message has none.
`ok`. dry_run이면 변환된 메시지와 경로(JSON): `ok`. With dry_run, the converted message and the route (JSON)
경보 하나가 사건 하나가 됩니다. firing은 발생, resolved는: Each alert becomes one incident. firing opens it, and resolved resolves it.
Links the alerts of one notification as related incidents.
alertname, severity, environment/env를 읽습: Reads alertname, severity, and environment or env.
summary, description, message 중 하나를 요약으로: Uses summary, description, or message as the incident summary.
Incident IDs. With dry_run, the converted alert and the route for each alert.
서비스가 정해지지 않은 정적 토큰: A configured token that is not bound to a service
Some alerts were rejected. The others were processed.
Grafana webhook 연락처. panelURL·dashboardU: Grafana webhook contact point. panelURL and dashboardURL are preferred as the incident link.
For a Grafana contact point with the HTTP method set to PUT.
영구 실패, 지연, Socket Mode 끊김 등: Permanent failures, delays, a disconnected Socket Mode, and similar problems
Uptime Kuma webhook 알림(본문 형식 JSON)을 받습니다: Receives Uptime Kuma webhook notifications with a JSON body. DOWN opens an incident, and UP resolves the open incident of the same monitor. PENDING, MAINTENANCE, and test notifications create nothing. Send the token in the additional header {"Authorization": "Bearer <token>"}.
Uptime Kuma에는 심각도가 없어 여기서 정합니다. critical: Uptime Kuma has no severity, so set it here. critical is P1, error is P2, info is P4, and other values are P3.
처리하지 않음. ignored에 이유(test notification,: Not processed. ignored gives the reason, for example test notification, pending, maintenance, no open incident, or duplicate.
사건을 열거나 갱신하거나 해결했습니다. dry_run이면 200으로 변환: The incident was opened, updated, or resolved. With dry_run, the response is 200 with the converted event and the route.
필수 필드가 없거나 형식이 틀림: A required field is missing or malformed
Sentry 내부 통합의 webhook을 받습니다. Sentry-Hook: Receives webhooks from a Sentry internal integration. If Sentry-Hook-Resource is event_alert, it opens an incident for the issue. If it is issue and the action is resolved, it resolves the open incident. Other notifications are ignored. level fatal is P1, error is P2, warning is P3, and info and debug are P4.
클라이언트 토큰. Sentry 통합은 헤더를 추가할 수 없어 URL에 넣: Client token. Sentry integrations cannot add headers, so the token goes in the URL.
README의 Datadog webhook 템플릿으로 보낸 알림을 받습니: Receives notifications sent with the Datadog webhook template in the README. Notifications with the same cycle ($ALERT_CYCLE_KEY) form one incident, and transition Recovered resolves it. priority ($ALERT_PRIORITY) P1 is P1, P2 is P2, and P4 and P5 are P4. Without a priority, Warn transitions are P3 and others are P2.
Prometheus의 alertmanager 설정에 noti-mesh를: Set noti-mesh as the Alertmanager in the Prometheus configuration to send alerts without Alertmanager. Each alert becomes one incident. A resent alert only updates its end time. If an alert does not arrive again before endsAt, the incident is resolved.
alertname, severity, environment/env를 읽습: The server reads alertname, severity, and environment/env. Alerts with the same label set are the same alert.
If it is missing, the server uses the start of the same active alert or the receive time.
If this time has passed, the alert is resolved. If it is missing, the server uses 5 minutes after the receive time.
The list of invalid alerts. The server accepted the other alerts.
